patches.name: Appearance
patches.description: In-app appearance controls, adjustable from the Letterboxd Mods screen without re-patching: a true-black OLED surface, a custom accent colour (presets or any hex), and the bottom-navigation selected style. Applied at runtime via resource overlays on Android 12 and later. Needs the "Mod settings" patch.

patches.name: Brighter Watched-by stars
patches.description: Other people's star ratings in a film's "Watched by" row use a very dark grey (#445566) that is hard to read, especially on a black theme. This switches them to the lighter grey (#99AABB) the rest of the app already uses for other people's ratings. A small legibility fix, on by default.

patches.name: Denser poster grid
patches.description: Tightens the spacing around posters in grids so they render larger and closer together. Does not change the number of columns.

patches.name: Hide Video Store on home
patches.description: Removes the "Letterboxd Video Store" promo row from the Films tab. The Video Store itself, its settings and every other entry point are left untouched. Can be toggled from the "Mod settings" screen if that patch is also enabled.

patches.name: Hide ratings until watched
patches.description: Hides the community rating (average + histogram) on a film's page until you have marked that film as watched, covering it with a tap-to-reveal control. The reveal is per visit — leave the film and come back and it is hidden again. Only the film page is affected; ratings shown in lists, search and elsewhere are unchanged.

options.title: Reveal style
options.description: How the hidden rating is covered. 'Frosted panel' is an opaque panel with a label; 'Tap-to-show link' is a plain text link under the section title; 'Shimmer' is a continuously animating particle field; 'Tap to burst' is a static particle field that scatters when tapped.

patches.name: Match bottom nav to top bar color
patches.description: Paints Letterboxd's bottom navigation bar black (#000000), matching the top bar, instead of the default slate. Can be toggled from the "Mod settings" screen if that patch is also enabled; the change applies on the next app start. With "Material You theme" also on, this wins — turn it off to keep the Material You nav tint.

patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Repaints Letterboxd's dark chrome — window background, surfaces, cards, the top bar, tab strip, bottom nav and sheets — from the device's Material You palette on Android 12+ (no effect below). No accent or OLED options here; those live in the "Mod settings" screen. No effect on Jetpack Compose screens.

patches.name: Mod settings
patches.description: HOW TO OPEN: long-press the settings gear on your profile tab. — This adds a "Letterboxd Mods" screen that collects the other patches' options (theme, accent, hide ratings, hide video store, etc.) so you can change them inside the app instead of re-patching. Some changes apply immediately, others after a restart, and you'll be prompted either way.
